question: Gangaur festival is historically native to which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gangaur festival** is traditionally celebrated in the state of **Rajasthan**.
 
• It is one of the most important festivals in Rajasthan, observed in honor of Gauri, the wife of Lord Shiva, symbolizing marital bliss and conjugal happiness.
 
• Women, particularly those who are newly married, pray for the well-being of their husbands, while unmarried women pray for a good husband.
 
• The festival involves various rituals, including the making of clay idols of Gauri and Shiva, which are worshipped and later immersed in water bodies.
 
• Gangaur is celebrated with great enthusiasm and includes processions, traditional songs, and dances, making it a vibrant and colorful event.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The festival of Gangaur is celebrated in the month of **Chaitra** (March-April), starting the day after Holi and continuing for 18 days.
 
• It is also observed in some parts of Gujarat and Madhya Pradesh, but it is most prominent in Rajasthan.
 
• Historically, the festival has been celebrated for centuries and is deeply rooted in the cultural heritage of Rajasthan.
 
• During the festival, women dress in their best attire and adorn themselves with jewelry.
 
• The festival strengthens the bonds of love and affection between married couples and within families.
